notes: Part A is informational: the official 10-task dirichlet protocol is replaced BY DESIGN by the frozen manifest via the data-partition interface only

Part B is gating: it verifies the exact objects FedProTIP loads under run_fedprotip.py are the manifest's splits, including the first-arrival label remap, the test-pool eval restriction and the per-(client,task) partition

CIFAR public classes rotate across tasks per client; samples of already-arrived classes are dropped from that client's new-task training (FedProTIP has no replay path) and counted in the report/drops.json
